title: Business Development Representation - Strategic Accounts
jobDescription:

About The Role:

As we scale our Enterprise motion, we’re looking for a specialist who can crack net-new strategic accounts and land first meetings with Group CHROs, CXOs, and transformation leaders.

This is not a volume outbound role; It’s a strategic account-opening role!!!

You’ll identify the right accounts, map complex stakeholder networks, run multi-threaded outreach, leverage AI and research tools intelligently, and create opportunities that most teams assume are impossible


What’s Expected of You:

Who will thrive here :

  • People who’ve personally opened net-new enterprise logos.

  • People who use AI every day—not because it’s trendy, but because it helps them research better, personalize deeper, and reach executives more intelligently.

What we’re looking for:


  • 5 to 10yrs years in B2B SaaS in the inside sales function/SDR.

  • Proven experience opening net-new enterprise or conglomerate accounts

  • Strong track record of reaching senior decision-makers and creating first meetings

  • Enterprise SaaS background preferred; HCM/HR Tech ideal

  • Experience with platforms such as Workday, SuccessFactors, Oracle, ServiceNow, or similar enterprise ecosystems is a plus

title: Sr. Specialist/Manager - Finance Transformation
jobDescription:
Role: Senior Specialist/Manager – Finance Transformation

Location: Hyderabad

Darwinbox is the fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 900+ global enterprises to manage their 2.5 million+ employees across 116+ countries.

Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: DP World, Masafi, DIFC, Abu Dhabi Department of Finance, Nivea, Starbucks, Swiggy, DLF, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.

Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

Key Responsibilities

Darwinbox is building the next generation of its Finance function — one that goes beyond accounting, compliance and reporting to become a genuine business accelerator. We are looking for a Finance Transformation Specialist who sits at the intersection of Finance and Technology and helps drive this evolution.

You will lead and support initiatives that redesign core finance processes, build a centralized data and analytics backbone, drive AI adoption across the finance function, and elevate Finance to a value-driving partner to every business unit at Darwinbox.

You will work closely with Finance, Product, Engineering, Revenue Operations, and Business teams — translating business needs into technology solutions, automating manual workflows, and championing a culture of data-driven decision-making within Finance.

Finance Process Redesign, Systems & Digital Transformation

  • Map, analyze, and redesign end-to-end finance processes across Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Financial Close, FP&A, Controllership, and Legal & Tax.

  • Identify and eliminate manual, repetitive, or error-prone steps; replace with system-driven controls and automated workflows.

  • Partner with Engineering/IT, Consultants on ERP enhancements, integrations — leading requirement gathering, solution design, UAT, and post-go-live stabilization.

  • Improve data flows and integrations between finance and business systems; act as the Finance voice in cross-functional product and technology roadmap discussions.

  • Build and maintain process documentation, SOPs, and process-flow diagrams; define and track process health KPIs (cycle times, error rates, SLA adherence) to drive continuous improvements

Centralized Finance Data Lake & Master Data Management

• Own and drive the creation of a centralised Finance Data Lake and Master Data Management (MDM) programme — consolidating data from CRM, ERP, billing, HRMS, and other downstream systems into a unified, governed data store.

• Define the Finance data architecture: data models, entity hierarchies, lineage documentation, and refresh cadences.

• Ensure data quality, consistency, and auditability across all Finance reporting and analytics surfaces.

• Collaborate with Engineering and Data Platform teams to build scalable pipelines; work with BI teams to surface clean, trusted data in dashboards and reports.

AI Adoption & Intelligent Finance

• Champion and drive the adoption of AI across the Finance function — making AI a core part of how Finance operates, not an afterthought.

• Identify and deliver high-impact AI use cases, including:

a. Intelligent cash-flow forecasting and scenario modelling

b. Anomaly detection in transactions, invoices, and expense claims

c. Natural language Finance co-pilot for self-serve reporting and analysis

d. Automated reconciliation and period-close acceleration

e. Predictive DSO management and collections prioritisation

• Build AI literacy across the Finance team through demos, workshops, and structured adoption programmes; establish governance and data-privacy guardrails for responsible AI use.

• Evaluate and deploy AI capabilities in partnership with Product and Engineering — covering both in-house builds and third-party tools.

Reporting, Analytics & Finance Intelligence

• Build and maintain executive and operational dashboards in BI tools covering revenue, collections, costs, headcount, and other Finance KPIs; automate MIS and management reporting packs to eliminate manual assembly effort.

• Develop a self-serve analytics layer so Finance business partners and business leaders can access trusted data without routing every query through the Finance team.

• Perform deep-dive analyses on business performance, cost trends, and process bottlenecks — translating data into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership.

Finance as a Business Accelerator & Stakeholder Partnership

• Elevate Finance from an accounting/reporting function to a proactive business partner — bringing Finance intelligence earlier into strategic conversations on pricing, deal economics, margin improvement, and investment decisions.

• Structure and deliver Finance transformation projects end-to-end — scoping, design, implementation, and adoption; manage cross-functional stakeholders, project trackers, risk registers, and escalations.

• Support Finance leadership on strategic and operational initiatives, contributing to a culture of curiosity, data-driven thinking, and continuous improvement across the Finance organization.

Who are we looking for?

  • Finance & Domain Knowledge

    • Deep understanding of core Finance processes: O2C, P2P, FP&A, Controllership, Financial Close, and Reporting is mandatory

    • Working knowledge of ERP systems (NetSuite preferred; SAP, Oracle, or Dynamics acceptable) is mandatory

    • Familiarity with SaaS business models, ARR/MRR metrics, and RevOps workflows is a strong advantage.

  • Technology & Data

    • Strong hands-on skills in data analysis — Excel;

    • Experience with SQL, Python, Power BI or equivalent BI tools for dashboard and report development would be a plus.

    • Exposure to data engineering concepts — data modelling, pipelines, data lakes, or MDM — is highly valued.

    • Familiarity with AI/ML applications in a Finance or enterprise context is a strong differentiator.

  • Execution & Mindset

    • Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills; comfort with ambiguity and greenfield problem spaces.

    • Self-driven with high execution focus; able to manage multiple concurrent projects and priorities.

    • Genuine curiosity about technology, AI, and the future of Finance.

Qualifications:

  • Must-Have

    • Chartered Accountant (CA), CMA, MBA (Finance), or equivalent qualifications.

    • 4–10 years of experience in Finance Transformation, Finance Operations, FP&A, Consulting, or Process Excellence roles.

    • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or similar).

    • Demonstrated experience in automation, data analytics, or digital finance initiatives.

    • Prior experience in SaaS, technology, or high-growth organizations is strongly preferred.

title: AI-Native Systems Builder
jobDescription:
AI-Native Systems Builder

We're looking for builders.

Not product managers. Not software engineers. Not AI researchers. People who happen to do all three when the problem demands it — because they care more about solving the problem than about which lane it falls in.

What this role is

Darwinbox is an enterprise HCM platform used by hundreds of large organizations across multiple countries. We're in the middle of a fundamental shift — rearchitecting the product and the company to be AI-native. Not adding AI features to an existing system. Rebuilding how the system thinks, operates, and delivers value.

This role exists because the most important work in that transformation doesn't fit traditional job boundaries. It sits at the intersection of product thinking, systems engineering, enterprise domain knowledge, and AI — and it requires people who can hold all of that in their head while shipping something that actually works.

You will take ambiguous, high-stakes enterprise problems and turn them into working systems. Some will be customer-facing product capabilities. Some will be internal operational systems. All of them will require you to think deeply about the realities of enterprise software — permissions, auditability, multi-tenancy, scale, configurability, edge cases — because that's where most "AI-powered" systems quietly break.

What the work looks like

You won't get a detailed spec. You'll get a problem.

It might sound like: "Our customers can't tell whether their employees are actually using the platform — and neither can we." Or: "Implementation consultants spend 40% of their time on work that should be systematized." Or: "This workflow was designed for humans filling forms — redesign it for a world where AI handles 80% of the steps."

Your job is to go from that problem statement to a production system. You'll need to understand the business context, design the solution, build it (using AI-native development workflows extensively), validate it against real enterprise complexity, and iterate until it works — not in a demo, but at scale, with real customers, in production.

Who thrives here

People who build things outside of work — not because someone asked, but because they saw a problem and couldn't leave it unsolved.

People who use AI tools daily and have strong opinions about where they're transformative and where they're dangerous.

People who think in systems — who instinctively ask "what breaks downstream?" and "what happens at 100x scale?" and "what's the edge case no one mentioned?"

People who've shipped things. Not prototyped. Shipped. In environments where the user didn't forgive rough edges.

You might come from engineering, product, consulting, design, operations, or a path that doesn't have a clean label. We genuinely don't care about the label. We care about how you think, how you simplify, and what you've built.

What we explicitly don't optimize for

  • Resume pedigree as a proxy for capability
  • Interview performance on problems you'd never encounter here
  • AI enthusiasm without AI execution
  • Coordination-heavy profiles that produce slides instead of systems
  • Prototype thinking without production realism

Why this role exists

Most companies hire PMs to write specs, engineers to execute them, and analysts to measure the outcome. Three roles, three handoffs, three points of context loss.

We're building a company where one person can hold the full arc — problem to system to outcome — because we believe that's how the best enterprise software gets built in the AI era.

If that sounds like how you already think, we should talk.
